dialogue.context: Sarah sedang meminta petunjuk arah ke apotek karena dia merasa tidak enak badan. Dia bertanya kepada seorang petugas informasi di stasiun kereta.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Excuse me, I'm not feeling well. Is there a pharmacy near here?
lines.translation: Permisi, saya tidak enak badan. Apakah ada apotek di dekat sini?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Yes, there's one just two blocks away. Go straight ahead, then turn right at the traffic light.
lines.translation: Ya, ada satu yang hanya dua blok dari sini. Jalan lurus ke depan, lalu belok kanan di lampu lalu lintas.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Turn right at the traffic light. Got it. How long does it take to walk there?
lines.translation: Belok kanan di lampu lalu lintas. Mengerti. Berapa lama waktu yang dibutuhkan untuk berjalan ke sana?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: About five minutes. The pharmacy is next to a small café. You can't miss it.
lines.translation: Sekitar lima menit. Apoteknya ada di sebelah kafe kecil. Anda pasti menemukannya.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Thank you so much for your help. I really appreciate it.
lines.translation: Terima kasih banyak atas bantuan Anda. Saya sangat menghargainya.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: You're welcome. I hope you feel better soon. Take care!
lines.translation: Sama-sama. Semoga Anda cepat sembuh. Hati-hati!

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih untuk ujian kelulusan dengan Mr. Khoirul. Dia akan mengajukan beberapa pertanyaan tentang pengalaman Anda kemarin dan situasi sehari-hari. Jawablah dengan kalimat lengkap dan natural.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Welcome to your speaking practice session. Let's start with a simple question: What did you do yesterday?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi Mr. Khoirul! Yesterday, I went to the supermarket and bought some vegetables.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's great! Now, imagine you're at a restaurant. The waiter asks what you'd like to order. What would you say?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'd like to have a chicken salad and a glass of orange juice, please.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! Now, can you tell me how to get to the library from your house?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Sure! Go straight ahead for about ten minutes, then turn left at the corner. The library is on your right.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent directions! One last question: Describe your bedroom. What furniture do you have there?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My bedroom has a bed, a desk, a chair, and a wardrobe. I also have a small bookshelf next to the window.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Excuse me, where is the post office?' 'Go straight ahead for two blocks, then turn left. It's next to the bank.' What should the person do FIRST?
quiz.explanation: Dalam transkrip, instruksi pertama yang diberikan adalah 'Go straight ahead for two blocks' sebelum instruksi 'turn left'. Jadi tindakan pertama yang harus dilakukan adalah berjalan lurus ke depan.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'I went to the doctor yesterday because I had a bad headache. The doctor gave me some medicine and told me to rest.' Why did the speaker go to the doctor?
quiz.explanation: Speaker secara jelas menyatakan 'I went to the doctor yesterday because I had a bad headache'. Kata 'because' menunjukkan alasan kunjungan ke dokter adalah karena sakit kepala.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'The train to Manchester leaves from platform 7 at 3:15 PM. Please be there 10 minutes before departure.' What time should passengers arrive at the platform?
quiz.explanation: Kereta berangkat pukul 3:15 PM dan penumpang diminta tiba 10 menit sebelumnya. 3:15 dikurangi 10 menit adalah 3:05 PM.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Welcome to Green's Restaurant. Here's your menu. Would you like to order drinks first?' 'Yes, I'd like a cup of coffee, please.' What does the customer want?
quiz.explanation: Ketika ditanya apakah ingin memesan minuman, customer menjawab 'I'd like a cup of coffee, please', jadi yang diinginkan customer adalah secangkir kopi.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'Tom's Supermarket has a big sale this weekend! All fruits and vegetables are 30% off. Fresh bread is only $2. The store opens at 8 AM and closes at 9 PM on Saturday and Sunday.' What is the discount on fruits?
quiz.explanation: Dalam teks disebutkan dengan jelas 'All fruits and vegetables are 30% off', yang berarti semua buah dan sayuran mendapat potongan harga 30%.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'My name is Lisa. I live in a small house with two bedrooms, one bathroom, a kitchen, and a living room. My bedroom is on the second floor. I have a desk, a bed, and a bookshelf in my room.' Where is Lisa's bedroom?
quiz.explanation: Lisa secara eksplisit menyatakan 'My bedroom is on the second floor', yang berarti kamar tidurnya berada di lantai dua.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'Yesterday was very busy for me. I woke up at 7 AM, ate breakfast, and went to work at 8:30 AM. After work, I went to the gym for one hour. Then I bought some groceries at the supermarket before going home.' What did the person do after work?
quiz.explanation: Urutan kegiatan setelah kerja adalah: 'After work, I went to the gym for one hour. Then I bought some groceries'. Jadi aktivitas pertama setelah kerja adalah pergi ke gym.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'City Bus Route 12 goes from Central Station to Park Avenue. The first bus leaves at 6 AM. Buses run every 20 minutes. A single ticket costs $2.50.' How often do the buses run?
quiz.explanation: Teks menyatakan 'Buses run every 20 minutes', yang berarti bus beroperasi setiap 20 menit sekali.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Which sentence correctly uses the past tense of irregular verbs?
options: I goed to the store and buyed milk yesterday.
I went to the store and bought milk yesterday.
I go to the store and buy milk yesterday.
quiz.answer: I went to the store and bought milk yesterday.
quiz.explanation: Bentuk lampau dari 'go' adalah 'went' dan 'buy' adalah 'bought'. Kalimat ini juga menggunakan time marker 'yesterday' yang menunjukkan past tense. 'Goed' dan 'buyed' adalah bentuk salah.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Complete the sentence with the correct word: 'The pharmacy is ___ the bank and the post office.'
quiz.explanation: Preposisi 'between' digunakan untuk menunjukkan posisi di antara dua tempat. 'The pharmacy is between the bank and the post office' berarti apotek berada di antara bank dan kantor pos.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: She have three bedroom in her house.
She has three bedrooms in her house.
She has three bedroom in her house.
quiz.answer: She has three bedrooms in her house.
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'she' (orang ketiga tunggal) memerlukan 'has', bukan 'have'. Kata 'bedroom' harus plural 'bedrooms' karena jumlahnya tiga. Jadi kalimat yang benar adalah 'She has three bedrooms in her house.'

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Rearrange the words to make a correct question: 'did / what / eat / you / for / breakfast'?
options: What you did eat for breakfast?
What did you eat for breakfast?
What eat you did for breakfast?
quiz.answer: What did you eat for breakfast?
quiz.explanation: Struktur pertanyaan dalam simple past dengan 'what' adalah: What + did + subject + verb (base form) + ...? Jadi urutan yang benar adalah 'What did you eat for breakfast?'

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] A customer asks: 'How much is this shirt?' What is the most appropriate response from a shop assistant?
quiz.explanation: Respons yang paling profesional dan sopan dari seorang asisten toko adalah langsung memberikan informasi harga yang jelas seperti 'It's $25'. Pilihan lain tidak sopan atau tidak membantu.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Someone says: 'Thank you for helping me find the way.' What is the best polite response?
options: You're welcome. Have a nice day!
quiz.answer: You're welcome. Have a nice day!
quiz.explanation: Respons yang paling sopan dan ramah untuk ucapan terima kasih adalah 'You're welcome' diikuti dengan kalimat positif seperti 'Have a nice day!' untuk menunjukkan keramahan.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] You're at a restaurant and the waiter asks: 'Are you ready to order?' But you need more time. What should you say?
options: Not yet, can I have a few more minutes, please?
quiz.answer: Not yet, can I have a few more minutes, please?
quiz.explanation: Cara yang sopan untuk meminta waktu tambahan adalah mengatakan 'Not yet, can I have a few more minutes, please?' Ini menunjukkan kesopanan dengan menggunakan 'please' dan menjelaskan bahwa Anda masih memerlukan waktu.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] A doctor asks: 'How are you feeling today?' You still have a headache. What's the most appropriate answer?
options: I still have a headache, doctor.
quiz.answer: I still have a headache, doctor.
quiz.explanation: Ketika dokter menanyakan kondisi Anda, penting untuk jujur dan spesifik tentang gejala yang Anda rasakan. 'I still have a headache, doctor' adalah jawaban yang tepat dan informatif bagi dokter.

modules.title: Comparative Adjectives: Comparing People & Things
modules.objective: Mampu membandingkan dua orang, benda, atau tempat menggunakan bentuk comparative (-er than, more ... than)

theory.summary: Comparative adjectives digunakan untuk membandingkan dua orang, benda, atau tempat. Dalam bahasa Inggris, ada dua cara membentuk comparative: menambahkan -er untuk kata sifat pendek (tall → taller) atau menggunakan more untuk kata sifat panjang (expensive → more expensive). Dengan menguasai pola ini, kamu bisa mengekspresikan perbandingan dengan lebih natural dan percaya diri!
rules: Untuk kata sifat pendek (1 suku kata), tambahkan -er + than: tall → taller than, big → bigger than, fast → faster than
Untuk kata sifat panjang (2+ suku kata), gunakan more + adjective + than: expensive → more expensive than, beautiful → more beautiful than, difficult → more difficult than
Kata sifat tidak beraturan (irregular): good → better than, bad → worse than, far → farther/further than. Contoh: This phone is better than my old one. Today's weather is worse than yesterday.

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula mencampur aturan comparative dengan menambahkan more dan -er sekaligus, atau lupa menggunakan than setelah comparative adjective.
commonTrap.wrong: This bag is more cheaper than that one.
commonTrap.correct: This bag is cheaper than that one.

vocab.collocation: My brother is taller than me.
The iPhone is more expensive than the Samsung.
A cheetah is faster than a lion.
This sofa is more comfortable than that chair.
Jakarta is more crowded than Bandung.
This market is cheaper than the mall.
The new building is more modern than the old one.
My backpack is heavier than yours.
This book is more interesting than that movie.
She is smarter than her classmates.

dialogue.context: Dua teman, Lisa dan Andi, sedang membandingkan smartphone baru mereka di sebuah kafe.

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: Hey Andi, is that your new phone? It looks nice!
lines.translation: Hei Andi, itu ponsel barumu? Terlihat bagus!

lines.speaker: Andi
lines.text: Yes! I just bought it yesterday. It's bigger than my old phone.
lines.translation: Ya! Aku baru membelinya kemarin. Ini lebih besar dari ponsel lamaku.

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: How much did it cost? Is it more expensive than mine?
lines.translation: Berapa harganya? Apakah lebih mahal dari punyaku?

lines.speaker: Andi
lines.text: Actually, it's cheaper than yours. I got it on sale.
lines.translation: Sebenarnya, lebih murah dari punyamu. Aku membelinya saat diskon.

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: That's great! Is the camera better than your old one?
lines.translation: Itu bagus! Apakah kameranya lebih baik dari yang lama?

lines.speaker: Andi
lines.text: Yes, much better! The photos are clearer and the battery lasts longer too.
lines.translation: Ya, jauh lebih baik! Fotonya lebih jernih dan baterainya juga lebih tahan lama.

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: Sounds perfect. Maybe I should buy one too!
lines.translation: Kedengarannya sempurna. Mungkin aku juga harus beli satu!

lines.speaker: Andi
lines.text: You should! It's faster than most phones in this price range.
lines.translation: Kamu harus beli! Ini lebih cepat dari kebanyakan ponsel di rentang harga ini.

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berbincang dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang perbandingan antara dua kota: Jakarta dan Surabaya. Mr. Khoirul akan menanyakan pendapatmu dan membantumu berlatih menggunakan comparative adjectives dengan natural.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Have you ever been to both Jakarta and Surabaya?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I have visited both cities.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Great! Which city do you think is bigger?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Jakarta is bigger than Surabaya.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's correct! Now, tell me about the traffic. Which city has worse traffic?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think Jakarta has worse traffic than Surabaya.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good comparison! What about the food? Which city do you think has more delicious food?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Both are great, but I think Surabaya has more delicious street food than Jakarta.

quiz.question: My house is ___ than your apartment.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'big' adalah kata sifat pendek (1 suku kata), jadi kita tambahkan -er untuk membentuk comparative. Huruf konsonan terakhir digandakan menjadi 'bigger'. Tidak boleh menggunakan 'more' dengan -er secara bersamaan.

quiz.question: This car is ___ than that motorcycle.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'expensive' adalah kata sifat panjang (3 suku kata), jadi kita gunakan 'more' di depannya untuk membentuk comparative, bukan menambahkan -er. Pola yang benar: more + adjective + than.

quiz.question: The weather today is ___ than yesterday.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'bad' adalah irregular adjective (tidak beraturan). Bentuk comparative-nya adalah 'worse', bukan 'badder' atau 'more bad'. Ini harus dihafalkan karena tidak mengikuti aturan umum.

quiz.question: An elephant is ___ than a rabbit.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'heavy' adalah kata sifat 2 suku kata yang berakhiran -y. Untuk membentuk comparative, kita ubah -y menjadi -i lalu tambahkan -er, sehingga menjadi 'heavier'. Tidak menggunakan 'more'.

quiz.question: Learning English is ___ than I thought.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'easy' berakhiran -y, jadi untuk membentuk comparative kita ubah -y menjadi -i dan tambahkan -er, menjadi 'easier'. Meskipun 2 suku kata, kata yang berakhiran -y mengikuti pola -er, bukan more.

modules.title: Superlative Adjectives: The Best & The Most Exciting
modules.objective: Mampu menyatakan yang paling/ter- di antara suatu kelompok menggunakan superlative (the -est, the most ...)

theory.summary: Superlative adjectives digunakan untuk menyatakan tingkat paling tinggi dari suatu sifat di antara tiga atau lebih hal. Dalam bahasa Indonesia, ini seperti kata 'ter-' (terbesar, tertinggi, terindah). Superlative selalu diawali dengan 'the' dan membantu kita membandingkan satu hal dengan semua hal lainnya dalam kelompok.
rules: Untuk kata sifat pendek (1 suku kata): gunakan the + -est. Contoh: tall → the tallest, big → the biggest, old → the oldest.
Untuk kata sifat panjang (2+ suku kata): gunakan the most + kata sifat. Contoh: interesting → the most interesting, beautiful → the most beautiful, expensive → the most expensive.

Kata sifat tidak beraturan (irregular): good → the best, bad → the worst, far → the farthest. Contoh kalimat: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world. This is the most delicious food I've ever tasted.

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula lupa menambahkan 'the' di depan superlative, atau salah menggunakan '-est' untuk kata sifat panjang. Ingat: superlative SELALU pakai 'the', dan kata sifat panjang pakai 'the most', bukan '-est'.
commonTrap.wrong: She is most beautiful girl in class. / This is expensivest car.
commonTrap.correct: She is the most beautiful girl in class. / This is the most expensive car.

vocab.collocation: He is the tallest student in our class.
This is the biggest shopping mall in the city.
That was the most interesting story I've heard.
The Eiffel Tower is the most famous monument in Paris.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
The Amazon is the longest river in South America.
It was the most exciting game of the season.
This is the most expensive restaurant in town.
She broke the world record for the fastest sprint.
This is the most delicious cake I've ever tasted.

dialogue.context: Dua teman, Sarah dan Kevin, sedang membicarakan tempat wisata yang pernah mereka kunjungi dan berbagi pengalaman tentang rekor dunia.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Hi Kevin! I just visited the tallest building in the city yesterday.
lines.translation: Hai Kevin! Aku baru saja mengunjungi gedung tertinggi di kota ini kemarin.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Really? That's amazing! Was it exciting?
lines.translation: Benarkah? Itu menakjubkan! Apakah itu menggembirakan?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes! It was the most exciting experience ever. The view was incredible.
lines.translation: Ya! Itu pengalaman paling menggembirakan yang pernah ada. Pemandangannya luar biasa.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: I want to go there too! By the way, do you know the longest river in the world?
lines.translation: Aku juga ingin ke sana! Ngomong-ngomong, apakah kamu tahu sungai terpanjang di dunia?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I think it's the Nile River in Africa. It's the longest one.
lines.translation: Aku pikir itu Sungai Nil di Afrika. Itu yang terpanjang.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: You're right! And Mount Everest is the highest mountain. I learned that in geography class.
lines.translation: Kamu benar! Dan Gunung Everest adalah gunung tertinggi. Aku mempelajari itu di kelas geografi.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That's correct! World records are so interesting to learn about.
lines.translation: Itu benar! Rekor dunia sangat menarik untuk dipelajari.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: I agree! Learning about the best and the biggest things in the world is fun.
lines.translation: Aku setuju! Belajar tentang hal-hal terbaik dan terbesar di dunia itu menyenangkan.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih berbicara dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang hal-hal favorit dan rekor dunia. Mr. Khoirul akan menanyakan pendapat Anda tentang berbagai hal menggunakan superlative adjectives, dan Anda diminta merespons dengan kalimat yang tepat.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we'll talk about the best and the most interesting things. What's the most beautiful place you've ever visited?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The most beautiful place I've visited is Bali. The beaches are amazing.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Wonderful! Bali is indeed beautiful. Now, can you tell me what's the biggest animal in the world?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The biggest animal in the world is the blue whale.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! That's correct. What about in your family? Who is the tallest person?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My father is the tallest person in my family.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Great answer! Last question: What's the most exciting sport to watch in your opinion?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think football is the most exciting sport to watch because it's very fast and intense.

quiz.question: Mount Everest is ___ mountain in the world.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'high' adalah kata sifat pendek (1 suku kata), jadi kita gunakan 'the highest' (the + -est). Bukan 'the most high' karena itu untuk kata sifat panjang.

quiz.question: This is ___ restaurant in the city. The food is very expensive.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'expensive' adalah kata sifat panjang (3 suku kata), jadi kita gunakan 'the most expensive'. Tidak ada bentuk 'expensivest' dalam bahasa Inggris.

quiz.question: She is ___ student in our class. She always gets perfect scores.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'good' adalah irregular adjective (tidak beraturan). Bentuk superlative-nya adalah 'the best', bukan 'the goodest' atau 'the most good'.

quiz.question: The Nile is ___ river in Africa.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'long' adalah kata sifat pendek (1 suku kata), jadi bentuk superlative-nya adalah 'the longest' (the + -est).

quiz.question: That was ___ movie I've ever watched. I fell asleep!
quiz.explanation: Kata 'boring' adalah kata sifat panjang (2 suku kata), jadi kita gunakan 'the most boring'. Kata sifat yang berakhiran -ing biasanya menggunakan 'the most'.

modules.title: Holiday Experiences & Travel Memories
modules.objective: Mampu menceritakan pengalaman liburan masa lalu secara detail (tujuan, akomodasi, aktivitas, dan kesan)

theory.summary: Dalam modul ini, kamu akan belajar menceritakan pengalaman liburan masa lalu dengan detail. Kamu akan menggunakan Past Simple Tense untuk menjelaskan ke mana kamu pergi, di mana kamu menginap, apa yang kamu lakukan, dan bagaimana kesan atau perasaanmu. Ini sangat berguna saat berbagi cerita liburan dengan teman atau keluarga dalam bahasa Inggris.
rules: Gunakan Past Simple untuk menceritakan aktivitas yang sudah selesai: Subject + Verb 2 (went, stayed, visited, bought). Contoh: 'I went to Bali last month.'
Gunakan 'was/were' untuk mendeskripsikan kondisi atau keadaan di masa lalu: It was amazing / The beaches were beautiful. Contoh: 'The hotel was comfortable and the staff were friendly.'
Rangkai cerita dengan kata penghubung waktu: first, then, after that, finally. Contoh: 'First, we checked in at the hotel. Then, we went sightseeing.'

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering lupa mengubah kata kerja ke bentuk past tense atau mencampur present dan past tense dalam satu cerita. Pastikan semua kata kerja menggunakan bentuk lampau saat menceritakan liburan yang sudah terjadi.
commonTrap.wrong: Last week, I go to the beach and I buy some souvenirs.
commonTrap.correct: Last week, I went to the beach and I bought some souvenirs.

vocab.collocation: I went on holiday to Thailand last summer.
Our flight to Singapore was delayed for two hours.
We stayed at a nice hotel near the beach.
The beach was beautiful and the water was clear.
We went sightseeing around the old city centre.
I bought some souvenirs for my family and friends.
We visited three famous museums during our trip.
The view from the mountain was absolutely incredible.
Our room was small but very cozy and comfortable.
The local food was fresh and delicious.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom bertemu di kantor setelah liburan akhir pekan. Mereka berbagi cerita tentang pengalaman liburan mereka masing-masing.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Hi Tom! How was your weekend trip to Yogyakarta?
lines.translation: Hai Tom! Bagaimana perjalanan akhir pekanmu ke Yogyakarta?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It was incredible! We stayed at a cozy hotel near Malioboro Street.
lines.translation: Luar biasa! Kami menginap di hotel yang nyaman dekat Jalan Malioboro.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That sounds great! What did you do there?
lines.translation: Kedengarannya bagus! Apa yang kamu lakukan di sana?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: We visited Borobudur Temple and Prambanan. The views were amazing!
lines.translation: Kami mengunjungi Candi Borobudur dan Prambanan. Pemandangannya menakjubkan!

modules.title: Future Plans & Intentions with 'Be Going To'
modules.objective: Mampu menyampaikan rencana masa depan dan niat yang sudah diputuskan menggunakan struktur 'be going to + verb'

theory.summary: Struktur 'be going to' digunakan untuk menyatakan rencana atau niat yang sudah kamu putuskan di masa depan. Ini berbeda dengan prediksi spontan. Bayangkan kamu sudah merencanakan sesuatu sebelumnya, seperti 'Aku akan belajar bahasa Inggris besok' (sudah direncanakan). Struktur ini sangat berguna untuk membicarakan kegiatan yang akan datang dengan orang lain.
rules: Rumus Positif: Subject + am/is/are + going to + verb (infinitive). Contoh: I am going to visit my grandmother tomorrow. (Aku akan mengunjungi nenekku besok.)
Rumus Negatif: Subject + am/is/are + not + going to + verb. Contoh: She is not going to buy that dress. (Dia tidak akan membeli gaun itu.)
Rumus Pertanyaan: Am/Is/Are + subject + going to + verb? Contoh: Are you going to study tonight? (Apakah kamu akan belajar malam ini?) Jawaban: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula lupa menambahkan 'to' setelah 'going', atau salah memilih bentuk 'be' (am/is/are) yang tidak sesuai dengan subjek. Ingat, setelah 'going to' harus diikuti kata kerja bentuk dasar (infinitive), bukan bentuk -ing atau past.
commonTrap.wrong: I am going visit my friend tomorrow. / She is going to visiting the museum.
commonTrap.correct: I am going to visit my friend tomorrow. / She is going to visit the museum.

modules.title: Describing Physical Appearance & Style
modules.objective: Mampu mendeskripsikan ciri-ciri fisik seseorang (tinggi badan, warna & model rambut, bentuk wajah, kacamata)

theory.summary: Dalam bahasa Inggris, kita menggunakan dua struktur utama untuk mendeskripsikan penampilan fisik seseorang: 'be' (am/is/are) untuk karakteristik permanen seperti tinggi badan dan warna mata, dan 'have got' atau 'has got' untuk fitur yang dimiliki seperti rambut dan aksesori. Memahami perbedaan ini akan membantu kamu mendeskripsikan orang dengan akurat dan natural.
rules: Gunakan 'be' (am/is/are) + adjective untuk mendeskripsikan karakteristik umum: He is tall. She is short. They are slim.
Gunakan 'have got' atau 'has got' untuk fitur yang dimiliki: I have got brown eyes. She has got curly hair. He has got a beard.
Gunakan 'wear' atau 'wears' untuk aksesori: She wears glasses. He wears a hat. They wear uniforms.

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula salah menggunakan 'is' untuk fitur yang seharusnya menggunakan 'has got', atau sebaliknya. Ingat: 'be' untuk karakteristik umum (tall, short, slim), 'have got' untuk fitur spesifik yang dimiliki (hair, eyes, beard).

commonTrap.correct: She has got long black hair. He is tall.

modules.title: Personalities, Character Traits & Feelings
modules.objective: Mampu mendeskripsikan sifat kepribadian teman dan suasana hati (cheerful, polite, honest, shy, confident)

theory.summary: Dalam bahasa Inggris, kita menggunakan kata sifat (adjectives) untuk mendeskripsikan kepribadian dan perasaan seseorang. Kata-kata seperti 'cheerful', 'polite', 'honest', 'shy', dan 'confident' membantu kita menjelaskan karakter teman atau orang lain. Untuk menjelaskan alasan mengapa kita menyukai seseorang, kita bisa menggunakan pola kalimat 'because' diikuti dengan kata sifat kepribadian. Misalnya: 'I like her because she is kind and friendly.' Pelajaran ini akan membantu kamu mengekspresikan pendapat tentang karakter orang lain dengan percaya diri.
rules: Kata sifat kepribadian diletakkan setelah 'to be' (is/am/are): He is friendly. She is confident. They are helpful.
Untuk menjelaskan alasan, gunakan 'because + subject + to be + adjective': Why do you like him? Because he is polite and generous.
Kata sifat bisa digabungkan dengan 'and' untuk mendeskripsikan lebih dari satu sifat: My friend is cheerful and creative. Tom is shy but very honest.

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula lupa menambahkan 'is/am/are' sebelum kata sifat kepribadian. Dalam bahasa Inggris, kata sifat harus didahului oleh 'to be' ketika mendeskripsikan seseorang.

commonTrap.correct: She is friendly and kind.

modules.title: Special Talents & Skills: 'Good at' & 'Bad at'
modules.objective: Mampu mengomunikasikan bakat, keahlian khusus, dan hal-hal yang dikuasai dengan baik menggunakan 'good at + -ing'

theory.summary: Dalam modul ini, kamu akan belajar cara mengekspresikan kemampuan dan bakat menggunakan 'good at' dan 'bad at'. Struktur ini digunakan untuk menjelaskan seberapa baik seseorang dalam melakukan sesuatu. Bedanya dengan 'can' adalah: 'can' menunjukkan kemampuan dasar (bisa/tidak bisa), sedangkan 'good at/bad at' menunjukkan tingkat keahlian atau seberapa mahir seseorang dalam aktivitas tersebut.
rules: Pola dasar: Subject + am/is/are + good/bad at + verb-ing. Contoh: I am good at swimming. She is bad at cooking.

Gunakan kata sifat tingkat untuk variasi: brilliant/excellent/great (sangat mahir), quite good (cukup baik), not very good (kurang baik), terrible/hopeless (sangat buruk). Contoh: He is brilliant at playing chess.
Setelah 'at' selalu gunakan verb-ing (gerund), bukan infinitive. Contoh: good at dancing (✓), bukan good at dance (✗). Bisa juga diikuti noun: good at math, bad at languages.

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula lupa bahwa setelah 'good at' atau 'bad at' harus menggunakan bentuk verb-ing (gerund), bukan bentuk dasar verb. Ini karena 'at' adalah preposisi yang harus diikuti oleh gerund atau noun.

commonTrap.correct: I am good at playing guitar.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's wonderful! How about languages? Are you good at learning new languages?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I'm quite good at learning languages. I'm studying English and French now.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Now, is there anything you're not very good at? We all have things we need to improve.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm bad at cooking. I always burn the food! I need more practice.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Don't worry! With practice, you'll improve. What about singing or dancing? Are you good at those?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm hopeless at singing, but I'm quite good at dancing. I take dance classes every week.

quiz.question: My brother ___ at playing the piano. He practices every day.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'is brilliant' karena subjeknya adalah 'my brother' (orang ketiga tunggal) sehingga menggunakan 'is'. Pola lengkapnya: Subject + is/am/are + adjective + at + verb-ing.

quiz.question: I'm not very good ___ remembering people's names.
quiz.explanation: Preposisi yang tepat setelah 'good' atau 'bad' adalah 'at', bukan 'in' atau 'on'. Ini adalah pola tetap dalam bahasa Inggris: good/bad at + verb-ing atau noun.

quiz.question: She is terrible at ___. She always gets lost!
quiz.explanation: Setelah preposisi 'at', verb harus dalam bentuk gerund (verb-ing). 'Reading maps' adalah bentuk yang benar, bukan 'read maps' atau 'reads maps'.

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: He is good at cook Italian food.
He is good at cooking Italian food.
He is good cooking Italian food.
quiz.answer: He is good at cooking Italian food.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat yang benar adalah 'He is good at cooking Italian food.' karena mengikuti pola: Subject + is + good at + verb-ing. Harus ada 'at' dan verb harus dalam bentuk -ing.

quiz.question: They ___ at organizing parties. Every event is amazing!
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'they' adalah jamak, sehingga menggunakan 'are', bukan 'is'. Kalimat lengkapnya memerlukan verb 'to be' sebelum adjective 'excellent': They are excellent at organizing parties.

modules.title: Polite Requests, Permission & Offers
modules.objective: Mampu meminta izin, meminta bantuan, dan menawarkan sesuatu secara santun (Could you, May I, Shall I)

theory.summary: Dalam bahasa Inggris, cara kita meminta sesuatu, meminta izin, atau menawarkan bantuan sangat penting untuk menunjukkan kesopanan. Ada tiga pola utama yang perlu kamu kuasai: 'Could you' untuk meminta bantuan, 'May I' untuk meminta izin, dan 'Shall I' untuk menawarkan bantuan. Menggunakan kata-kata ini membuat permintaanmu terdengar lebih sopan dan profesional dibandingkan dengan menggunakan 'can' atau perintah langsung.
rules: Could you + verb: Digunakan untuk meminta bantuan atau meminta seseorang melakukan sesuatu dengan sopan. Contoh: 'Could you please open the door?' atau 'Could you help me with this?'
May I + verb: Digunakan untuk meminta izin melakukan sesuatu. Ini lebih formal daripada 'Can I'. Contoh: 'May I borrow your pen?' atau 'May I come in?'

Shall I + verb: Digunakan untuk menawarkan bantuan kepada orang lain. Contoh: 'Shall I help you with your bag?' atau 'Shall I open the window?' Untuk menerima: 'Yes, please.' atau 'That would be nice.' Untuk menolak: 'No, thank you.' atau 'That's okay, thanks.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jangan Gunakan 'Can You' untuk Permintaan Sopan
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula menggunakan 'Can you' untuk meminta bantuan, padahal ini terdengar kurang sopan atau seperti mempertanyakan kemampuan seseorang. Dalam situasi formal atau saat berbicara dengan orang yang baru dikenal, 'Could you' jauh lebih tepat dan sopan.
commonTrap.wrong: Can you help me?
commonTrap.correct: Could you help me, please?

vocab.collocation: May I borrow your dictionary for a moment?
Could you lend me your phone charger, please?
I need to ask permission before leaving early.
Could you do me a favor and post this letter?
Would you mind closing the window? It's cold.
Shall I carry your shopping bags?
Sorry to interrupt, but may I ask a question?
I'm afraid I have to decline your offer.
Do you need any assistance with your luggage?
It's common courtesy to say please and thank you.

dialogue.context: Emma sedang bekerja di kantornya ketika ia membutuhkan bantuan dari rekan kerjanya, Daniel. Ia juga ingin meminjam pulpen dan menawarkan bantuan.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Good morning, Daniel. Could you help me with this report, please? I'm having trouble with the numbers.
lines.translation: Selamat pagi, Daniel. Bisakah kamu membantu saya dengan laporan ini? Saya kesulitan dengan angka-angkanya.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Of course, Emma. I'd be happy to help. What seems to be the problem?
lines.translation: Tentu saja, Emma. Saya dengan senang hati membantu. Apa masalahnya?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Thank you so much! Also, may I borrow your blue pen? Mine has run out of ink.
lines.translation: Terima kasih banyak! Juga, bolehkah saya meminjam pulpen biru Anda? Pulpen saya kehabisan tinta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes, certainly. Here you are. You can keep it until tomorrow if you need to.
lines.translation: Ya, tentu. Ini dia. Kamu bisa memakainya sampai besok kalau perlu.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: That's very kind of you. Oh, you have a lot of files there. Shall I help you carry them to the meeting room?
lines.translation: Kamu baik sekali. Oh, kamu punya banyak file di sana. Haruskah saya membantu membawanya ke ruang rapat?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That would be great, thank you! They're quite heavy.
lines.translation: Itu akan sangat membantu, terima kasih! Mereka cukup berat.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: No problem at all. Shall I also bring the laptop for the presentation?
lines.translation: Tidak masalah sama sekali. Haruskah saya juga membawa laptop untuk presentasi?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: No, thank you. I already have it in my bag. But I really appreciate your help with the files!
lines.translation: Tidak, terima kasih. Saya sudah menaruhnya di tas saya. Tapi saya sangat menghargai bantuan Anda dengan file-file ini!

speakingLab.context: Kamu berada di perpustakaan kampus dan Mr. Khoirul adalah pustakawan yang ramah. Praktikkan cara meminta izin, meminta bantuan, dan menawarkan sesuatu dengan sopan dalam situasi ini.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good afternoon! Welcome to the library. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good afternoon! May I use the computer in the corner for my research?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Yes, of course. You can use it for up to two hours. Do you have your student card with you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I do. Here it is. Could you also help me find books about British history, please?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Certainly! The history section is on the second floor. I have to take some books there anyway. Shall I show you where it is?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That would be wonderful, thank you! Also, may I borrow up to five books at a time?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Yes, students can borrow up to five books for two weeks. You're carrying a lot of things. Shall I help you carry your backpack upstairs?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: No, thank you. That's very kind, but I can manage. I really appreciate all your help today!

quiz.question: You want to ask your teacher if you can leave the classroom early. What is the most polite way to ask? '___ leave ten minutes early today? I have a doctor's appointment.'
quiz.explanation: 'May I' adalah cara paling sopan untuk meminta izin, terutama dalam situasi formal seperti berbicara dengan guru. 'Can I' lebih kasual dan 'Do I' tidak tepat untuk meminta izin.

quiz.question: Your friend is carrying heavy shopping bags. You want to offer help. What should you say? '___ help you with those bags?'
quiz.explanation: 'Shall I' digunakan untuk menawarkan bantuan kepada orang lain dengan sopan. 'May I' digunakan untuk meminta izin, dan 'Do I' tidak tepat dalam konteks ini.

quiz.question: You need someone to open the window because you can't reach it. What is the correct polite request? '___ open the window, please? It's very hot in here.'
quiz.explanation: 'Could you' adalah bentuk sopan untuk meminta seseorang melakukan sesuatu. 'Can you' kurang sopan untuk permintaan formal, dan 'May you' secara tata bahasa tidak benar untuk permintaan.

quiz.question: Someone offers to help you: 'Shall I carry your suitcase?' You don't need help. What is the polite way to decline? '___'
options: No, thank you. I can manage.
quiz.answer: No, thank you. I can manage.
quiz.explanation: Menolak tawaran dengan sopan memerlukan ucapan terima kasih dan penjelasan singkat. 'No, thank you. I can manage.' menunjukkan apresiasi terhadap tawaran sambil menolak dengan lembut. Jawaban 'No' terlalu langsung dan tidak sopan.

quiz.question: You want to borrow your colleague's stapler. Which sentence is the MOST polite? '___'
options: May I borrow your stapler, please?
quiz.answer: May I borrow your stapler, please?
quiz.explanation: 'May I borrow your stapler, please?' adalah yang paling sopan karena menggunakan 'May I' untuk izin, kata 'borrow' yang tepat, dan menambahkan 'please'. 'Give me' adalah perintah yang tidak sopan, dan 'Can I' kurang formal dibanding 'May I'.

modules.title: Explaining Reasons & Consequences: 'Because' & 'So'
modules.objective: Mampu menghubungkan dua klausa untuk menjelaskan sebab dan akibat dalam percakapan sehari-hari

theory.summary: Dalam percakapan sehari-hari, kita sering perlu menjelaskan alasan mengapa sesuatu terjadi atau apa akibat dari suatu kejadian. Bahasa Inggris menggunakan 'because' untuk menjelaskan alasan (sebab) dan 'so' untuk menjelaskan akibat. Dengan menguasai kedua kata hubung ini, kamu bisa membuat kalimat yang lebih lengkap dan natural saat bercerita atau menjawab pertanyaan 'Why?'
rules: BECAUSE menghubungkan AKIBAT + SEBAB. Pola: [Result] + because + [Reason]. Contoh: I stayed home because it was raining. (Saya tinggal di rumah karena hujan.)
SO menghubungkan SEBAB + AKIBAT. Pola: [Reason] + so + [Result]. Contoh: It was raining, so I stayed home. (Hujan, jadi saya tinggal di rumah.)
Gunakan 'because' untuk menjawab pertanyaan 'Why?'. Contoh: Why are you tired? → Because I worked late. Kedua kata ini menghubungkan dua klausa lengkap (subject + verb).

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering menukar posisi 'because' dan 'so'. Ingat: 'because' = hasil dulu baru alasan, 'so' = alasan dulu baru hasil. Jangan gunakan keduanya sekaligus dalam satu kalimat.
commonTrap.wrong: I was tired, so because I went to bed early.
commonTrap.correct: I was tired, so I went to bed early. / I went to bed early because I was tired.

vocab.collocation: I was exhausted after the long journey.
I missed the bus this morning.
We had to cancel the picnic because of the rain.
I'm in a hurry because I'm late for class.
I overslept this morning, so I was late.
The weather was bad, so we stayed inside.
What was the consequence of your decision?
The reason I called is because I need help.
There was heavy traffic, so I arrived late.
She didn't come to school because she was sick.

dialogue.context: Emma dan Tom berbincang tentang rencana akhir pekan mereka yang harus berubah karena cuaca buruk.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Hi Tom! Why didn't you come to the park yesterday?
lines.translation: Hai Tom! Mengapa kamu tidak datang ke taman kemarin?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I didn't come because the weather was terrible. It was raining all day!
lines.translation: Aku tidak datang karena cuacanya buruk sekali. Hujan seharian!

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Yes, I know. It was raining, so we cancelled the picnic too.
lines.translation: Ya, aku tahu. Karena hujan, kami juga membatalkan piknik.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's a shame! Why don't we plan something for next weekend?
lines.translation: Sayang sekali! Bagaimana kalau kita rencanakan sesuatu untuk akhir pekan depan?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Good idea! I'm free on Saturday because I finished all my homework.
lines.translation: Ide bagus! Aku bebas hari Sabtu karena aku sudah selesaikan semua PR.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Perfect! The weather forecast is good, so we can go hiking.
lines.translation: Sempurna! Prakiraan cuacanya bagus, jadi kita bisa pergi mendaki.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: I love hiking! I'm excited because I haven't been hiking for months.
lines.translation: Aku suka mendaki! Aku senang karena sudah berbulan-bulan tidak mendaki.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Me too! Let's meet at 8 AM because we need to start early.
lines.translation: Aku juga! Ayo kita ketemu jam 8 pagi karena kita harus berangkat pagi.

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berbincang dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang aktivitas kemarin dan rencana hari ini. Praktikkan penggunaan 'because' dan 'so' untuk menjelaskan alasan dan akibat dalam percakapan natural.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good morning! You look tired today. Why are you tired?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Khoirul! I'm tired because I stayed up late studying last night.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. What happened this morning? Did you have breakfast?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I overslept this morning, so I didn't have time for breakfast.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Oh no! That's not good. Why did you oversleep?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I overslept because my alarm didn't go off. I forgot to set it!

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That happens sometimes. What are your plans after class today?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm going home early because I need to rest. I'm really exhausted!

quiz.question: I went to bed early ___ I was exhausted.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'because' ketika akibat disebutkan dulu (went to bed early), kemudian diikuti alasan (I was exhausted). Pola: Result + because + Reason.

quiz.question: It was raining, ___ we stayed home.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'so' ketika alasan disebutkan dulu (it was raining), kemudian diikuti akibat (we stayed home). Pola: Reason + so + Result.

quiz.question: Why are you late? - ___ there was heavy traffic.
quiz.explanation: Untuk menjawab pertanyaan 'Why?', selalu gunakan 'Because' diikuti alasan. 'So' tidak digunakan untuk menjawab pertanyaan 'Why?'.

quiz.question: She didn't come to the party ___ she was sick.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini menyebutkan akibat dulu (didn't come to the party), kemudian alasan (she was sick). Gunakan 'because' untuk menghubungkan keduanya.

quiz.question: I missed the bus, ___ I had to walk to school.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini menyebutkan alasan dulu (missed the bus), kemudian akibatnya (had to walk). Gunakan 'so' untuk menunjukkan akibat dari situasi tersebut.

modules.title: Public Signs, Notices & Imperatives
modules.objective: Mampu memahami tanda peringatan di tempat umum, rambu keselamatan, dan instruksi langsung (Do not enter, Keep off the grass)

theory.summary: Tanda-tanda umum dan rambu keselamatan menggunakan kalimat imperatif (perintah) untuk memberikan instruksi langsung. Imperatif positif memberitahu kita untuk melakukan sesuatu (Push, Enter, Turn off), sedangkan imperatif negatif memberitahu kita untuk tidak melakukan sesuatu (Do not enter, No smoking, Keep off). Memahami tanda-tanda ini sangat penting untuk keselamatan dan mengikuti aturan di tempat umum.
rules: Imperatif positif: Verb (kata kerja dasar) + object/complement. Contoh: Push the door, Keep right, Turn off your phone
Imperatif negatif: Do not / Don't + verb OR No + noun/-ing. Contoh: Do not enter, Don't touch, No smoking, No parking
Tanda peringatan sering menggunakan kata-kata seperti: Caution, Warning, Danger, Emergency, Exit. Contoh: Caution: Wet floor, Emergency exit only, Danger: High voltage

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering menambahkan subjek (you, we) atau to sebelum verb dalam kalimat imperatif pada tanda-tanda umum. Tanda-tanda publik selalu langsung dan singkat tanpa subjek.
commonTrap.wrong: You push the door, Please to keep off the grass
commonTrap.correct: Push the door, Keep off the grass

vocab.collocation: Caution: Wet floor ahead.
Emergency exit on your right.
Please use the main entrance.
Exit through the back door.
Smoking is strictly forbidden here.
Please read the notice on the wall.
Photography is prohibited in this area.
Warning: Guard dogs on patrol.
Authorized personnel only beyond this point.
Be careful, the floor is slippery when wet.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom sedang berjalan-jalan di pusat perbelanjaan dan melihat berbagai tanda-tanda di sekitar mereka.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Look at that sign, Tom. It says 'Caution: Wet floor'.
lines.translation: Lihat tanda itu, Tom. Tulisannya 'Hati-hati: Lantai basah'.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Oh yes, we should walk carefully here. There's another sign over there.
lines.translation: Oh ya, kita harus berjalan hati-hati di sini. Ada tanda lain di sana.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: It says 'No smoking'. We can't smoke in this area.
lines.translation: Tulisannya 'Dilarang merokok'. Kita tidak boleh merokok di area ini.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's right. And look at the door - it says 'Push', not 'Pull'.
lines.translation: Benar. Dan lihat pintunya - tulisannya 'Dorong', bukan 'Tarik'.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I see an emergency exit sign too. It's important to know where they are.
lines.translation: Saya juga melihat tanda pintu darurat. Penting untuk tahu di mana lokasinya.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Definitely. Oh, there's a sign that says 'Turn off cell phones' near the cinema entrance.
lines.translation: Pasti. Oh, ada tanda bertuliskan 'Matikan ponsel' dekat pintu masuk bioskop.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, we need to turn off our phones before watching the movie.
lines.translation: Ya, kita perlu mematikan ponsel sebelum menonton film.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: And that sign says 'Keep off the grass' in the garden area.
lines.translation: Dan tanda itu bertuliskan 'Jangan injak rumput' di area taman.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang belajar dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang cara memahami dan menggunakan tanda-tanda umum dalam bahasa Inggris. Mr. Khoirul akan menunjukkan berbagai tanda dan meminta Anda menjelaskan artinya.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we'll practice reading public signs. Look at this sign: 'Caution: Wet floor'. What does it mean?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It means we should be careful because the floor is wet and slippery.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Now, what about this one: 'No parking'?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It means we cannot park our car in that area.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! Here's another: 'Emergency exit only'. When can we use this door?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We can only use this door in an emergency situation, not for normal use.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Very good! Last one: You see a sign that says 'Keep off the grass'. What should you do?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I should not walk on the grass. I should stay on the path or walkway.

quiz.question: What does the sign 'Push' on a door tell you to do? ___
options: Push the door away from you
quiz.answer: Push the door away from you
quiz.explanation: Tanda 'Push' adalah instruksi imperatif yang memberitahu kita untuk mendorong pintu menjauh dari kita, bukan menariknya.

quiz.question: If you see 'No smoking' sign, it means ___
options: You must not smoke in this area
quiz.answer: You must not smoke in this area
quiz.explanation: 'No smoking' adalah imperatif negatif yang melarang aktivitas merokok sama sekali di area tersebut. 'No + noun/-ing' berarti aktivitas tersebut dilarang total.

quiz.question: 'Caution: Wet floor' is a sign that ___
options: warns you to be careful because the floor is wet
tells you to clean the wet floor
asks you to make the floor wet
quiz.answer: warns you to be careful because the floor is wet
quiz.explanation: 'Caution' adalah kata peringatan yang meminta kita berhati-hati. Tanda ini memberitahu kita bahwa lantai basah dan mungkin licin, jadi kita harus berjalan dengan hati-hati.

quiz.question: The sign 'Emergency exit only' means ___
options: You can use this door anytime
This door is only for emergencies
quiz.answer: This door is only for emergencies
quiz.explanation: 'Emergency exit only' memberitahu kita bahwa pintu ini khusus untuk situasi darurat saja. Kata 'only' menekankan bahwa pintu tidak boleh digunakan dalam situasi normal.

quiz.question: When you see 'Keep off the grass', you should ___
quiz.explanation: 'Keep off' adalah imperatif yang berarti 'jangan mendekati' atau 'jangan menginjak'. Jadi 'Keep off the grass' berarti kita tidak boleh berjalan atau menginjak rumput tersebut.

modules.title: City Life vs Country Life: Pros & Cons
modules.objective: Mampu membandingkan kehidupan di kota besar dengan pedesaan menggunakan argumen sederhana dan kosa kata lingkungan

theory.summary: Dalam modul ini, kamu akan belajar membandingkan kehidupan di kota dan desa menggunakan kata sifat komparatif dan kosakata lingkungan. Kamu akan bisa menjelaskan kelebihan dan kekurangan masing-masing tempat tinggal dengan kalimat sederhana namun efektif.
rules: Gunakan comparative adjectives untuk membandingkan: adjective + -er + than (untuk kata pendek) atau more + adjective + than (untuk kata panjang). Contoh: 'Cities are busier than villages.' / 'The countryside is more peaceful than the city.'
Gunakan simple present tense untuk menyatakan fakta umum tentang kota dan desa: Subject + verb(s/es). Contoh: 'Cities have modern facilities.' / 'Villages have fresh air.'

Gunakan struktur 'There is/are...' untuk mendeskripsikan keberadaan sesuatu di tempat: There is/are + noun + in the city/countryside. Contoh: 'There is a lot of traffic in the city.' / 'There are many trees in the countryside.'

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula lupa menambahkan 'than' setelah kata sifat komparatif ketika membandingkan dua hal. Tanpa 'than', kalimat menjadi tidak lengkap dan membingungkan.
commonTrap.wrong: The city is more crowded the village.
commonTrap.correct: The city is more crowded than the village.

vocab.collocation: The shopping mall is very crowded on weekends.
There is heavy traffic in the city centre every morning.
Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.
Life in the countryside is quiet and peaceful.
Modern cities have better facilities like hospitals and schools.
I love the fresh air in the mountains.
The city streets are very noisy at night.
Living near the train station is very convenient.
Children in villages can enjoy nature every day.
City life can be stressful because of traffic and noise.

dialogue.context: Maya dan Tom sedang berdiskusi tentang tempat tinggal mereka. Maya tinggal di kota besar, sedangkan Tom tinggal di desa. Mereka membandingkan kehidupan di kedua tempat tersebut.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Tom, I think city life is more exciting than country life. There are many shopping malls and restaurants.
lines.translation: Tom, menurutku kehidupan kota lebih menarik daripada kehidupan desa. Ada banyak pusat perbelanjaan dan restoran.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's true, but the city is more crowded and noisy than the countryside. I prefer the peaceful village.
lines.translation: Itu benar, tapi kota lebih ramai dan berisik daripada pedesaan. Aku lebih suka desa yang tenang.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Yes, but there is a lot of traffic in the city. Sometimes it's very stressful. How is the air in your village?
lines.translation: Ya, tapi ada banyak lalu lintas di kota. Kadang sangat menegangkan. Bagaimana udaranya di desamu?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The air is fresher and cleaner than in the city. We have less pollution here because there are many trees.
lines.translation: Udaranya lebih segar dan bersih daripada di kota. Kami punya lebih sedikit polusi di sini karena ada banyak pohon.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That sounds wonderful! But are there good facilities in your village? Like hospitals and schools?
lines.translation: Kedengarannya indah! Tapi apakah ada fasilitas bagus di desamu? Seperti rumah sakit dan sekolah?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Well, the facilities are not as modern as in the city. But life here is healthier and more relaxing.
lines.translation: Yah, fasilitasnya tidak secanggih di kota. Tapi hidup di sini lebih sehat dan santai.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I agree. The countryside is better for health. Maybe I should visit your village sometime!
lines.translation: Aku setuju. Pedesaan lebih baik untuk kesehatan. Mungkin aku harus mengunjungi desamu suatu saat!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes, please come! You can enjoy the fresh air and beautiful nature here.
lines.translation: Ya, silakan datang! Kamu bisa menikmati udara segar dan alam yang indah di sini.

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berbicara dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang pengalamanmu tinggal di kota atau desa. Mr. Khoirul akan menanyakan pendapatmu tentang kelebihan dan kekurangan masing-masing tempat. Gunakan kata sifat komparatif dan kosakata yang sudah kamu pelajari.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today let's talk about where we live. Do you live in a city or in the countryside?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi, Mr. Khoirul! I live in a city.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Great! What do you like about city life? Can you tell me one advantage?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I like that cities have better facilities. There are many hospitals and schools.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a good point! But what about the disadvantages? Is there anything you don't like about the city?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, the city is more crowded than the countryside. There is also a lot of traffic and pollution.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I understand. Now, can you compare city life with country life? Which one is healthier, do you think?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think the countryside is healthier than the city because there is fresh air and less pollution.

quiz.question: The city is ___ than the village because there are many cars and people.
quiz.explanation: Kita menggunakan 'more crowded' (lebih ramai) untuk membandingkan kota dengan desa. 'Crowded' adalah kata sifat panjang (2 suku kata atau lebih), jadi kita gunakan 'more + adjective + than' untuk bentuk komparatif.

quiz.question: There ___ a lot of pollution in big cities.
quiz.explanation: Kita menggunakan 'is' karena 'pollution' adalah kata benda yang tidak dapat dihitung (uncountable noun). Struktur yang benar adalah 'There is + uncountable noun'.

quiz.question: Life in the countryside is ___ than in the city because it's quiet.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'peaceful' adalah kata sifat panjang (3 suku kata), jadi untuk bentuk komparatif kita gunakan 'more peaceful than', bukan menambahkan '-er' di akhir kata.

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Villages have fresh air than cities.
Villages have fresher air than cities.
Villages have more fresh air cities.
quiz.answer: Villages have fresher air than cities.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat yang benar menggunakan 'fresher' (lebih segar) karena 'fresh' adalah kata sifat pendek (1 suku kata), jadi kita tambahkan '-er' dan harus diikuti dengan 'than' untuk membandingkan.

quiz.question: Cities have better ___ like hospitals, schools, and shopping malls.
quiz.explanation: Kita menggunakan 'facilities' (bentuk jamak) karena konteks kalimat menunjukkan banyak fasilitas (hospitals, schools, shopping malls). Ejaan yang benar adalah 'facilities', bukan 'facilites'.

modules.title: Bridge to A2: Comprehensive Conversational Fluency
modules.objective: Mampu menggabungkan masa lalu, sekarang, dan rencana masa depan secara luwes dalam satu alur percakapan utuh

theory.summary: Di modul ini, kamu akan belajar menggabungkan cerita masa lalu, kondisi sekarang, dan rencana masa depan dalam satu percakapan yang mengalir natural. Bayangkan kamu bercerita tentang liburan: kamu bilang kemana kamu pergi minggu lalu (past), bagaimana perasaanmu sekarang (present), dan apa rencanamu besok (future with 'be going to'). Untuk menghubungkan ide-ide ini dengan lancar, kamu akan menggunakan kata penghubung seperti 'also', 'but', 'because', 'so', 'then', dan 'after that'. Ini adalah langkah penting menuju level A2 karena kamu tidak lagi berbicara dengan kalimat-kalimat terpisah, tapi mulai menceritakan pengalaman lengkap dengan alur yang jelas.
rules: Simple Past untuk menceritakan pengalaman yang sudah selesai: Subject + Verb 2 / was-were + ... | Contoh: 'I visited Bali last week.' / 'It was amazing.'
Present Simple/Continuous untuk kondisi atau kegiatan sekarang: Subject + Verb 1(s/es) / am-is-are + Ving | Contoh: 'I feel tired now.' / 'I'm relaxing at home.'
Be going to untuk rencana masa depan: Subject + am/is/are + going to + Verb 1 | Contoh: 'I'm going to travel again next month.'

Gunakan connector untuk menghubungkan ide: 'also' (menambahkan info), 'but' (kontras), 'because' (alasan), 'so' (hasil), 'then'/'after that' (urutan waktu) | Contoh: 'I went to the beach yesterday. It was sunny, so I swam a lot. After that, I ate seafood. Now I'm tired, but I'm going to rest.'

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering langsung melompat antar waktu tanpa kata penghubung, sehingga cerita jadi membingungkan. Atau mereka lupa mengubah bentuk verb sesuai tense yang dipakai.
commonTrap.wrong: I go to museum yesterday. I tired now. I sleep tomorrow.
commonTrap.correct: I went to the museum yesterday. I'm tired now, so I'm going to sleep early tomorrow.

dialogue.context: Dua teman, Lisa dan Tom, bertemu setelah liburan panjang. Mereka membicarakan apa yang sudah mereka lakukan, bagaimana keadaan mereka sekarang, dan rencana mereka ke depan.

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: Hi Tom! How was your holiday? I didn't see you last week.
lines.translation: Hai Tom! Bagaimana liburanmu? Aku tidak melihatmu minggu lalu.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It was amazing! I went to Yogyakarta with my family. We visited Borobudur and also explored the old city.
lines.translation: Luar biasa! Aku pergi ke Yogyakarta dengan keluargaku. Kami mengunjungi Borobudur dan juga menjelajahi kota tua.

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: That sounds wonderful! How do you feel now? Are you tired?
lines.translation: Kedengarannya menyenangkan! Bagaimana perasaanmu sekarang? Apakah kamu lelah?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes, I'm a bit exhausted because we walked a lot. But I'm happy and relaxed.
lines.translation: Ya, aku sedikit kelelahan karena kami banyak berjalan. Tapi aku senang dan santai.

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: I understand. So, what are you going to do this weekend? Any plans?
lines.translation: Aku mengerti. Jadi, apa yang akan kamu lakukan akhir pekan ini? Ada rencana?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I'm going to stay at home and rest. After that, I'm going to prepare for my presentation next Monday. How about you?
lines.translation: Aku akan tinggal di rumah dan beristirahat. Setelah itu, aku akan mempersiapkan presentasiku Senin depan. Bagaimana denganmu?

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: I stayed in Jakarta last week, but I'm going to visit my grandparents this Sunday. I miss them.
lines.translation: Aku tinggal di Jakarta minggu lalu, tapi aku akan mengunjungi kakek nenekku Minggu ini. Aku rindu mereka.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's nice! Enjoy your time with them. Then we can meet next week and have coffee together.
lines.translation: Bagus sekali! Nikmati waktumu dengan mereka. Lalu kita bisa bertemu minggu depan dan ngopi bersama.

speakingLab.context: Kamu akan berlatih percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul. Dia akan bertanya tentang aktivitasmu minggu lalu, bagaimana perasaanmu hari ini, dan apa rencanamu untuk besok. Cobalah menjawab dengan lengkap dan gunakan connector untuk menghubungkan ide-idemu. Ini adalah kesempatan untuk praktik berbicara dengan percaya diri!

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I'm happy to see you today. Tell me, what did you do last weekend? Did you go anywhere?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi Mr. Khoirul! Last weekend, I went to the park with my friends. We played badminton and also had a picnic.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That sounds fun! How was the weather? And how do you feel today after that active weekend?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The weather was sunny and nice. Today I feel good, but I'm a bit tired because I didn't sleep much.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. So you need some rest. What are you going to do tonight? Any plans to relax?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I'm going to watch a movie at home. After that, I'm going to sleep early because I have work tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good plan! And what about this coming weekend? Are you going to do something special?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm going to visit my cousin in Bandung. We're going to explore the city and try some local food. I'm excited!

quiz.question: I ___ to the beach yesterday. It was beautiful, so I ___ many photos.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini menceritakan kejadian yang sudah selesai di masa lalu (yesterday), jadi kita gunakan Simple Past. 'Go' berubah menjadi 'went' dan 'take' berubah menjadi 'took'. Kedua verb harus dalam bentuk past tense karena kejadiannya bersamaan di waktu lampau.

quiz.question: I'm tired now ___ I worked all day. I ___ going to rest tonight.
quiz.explanation: 'Because' digunakan untuk menjelaskan alasan (kenapa lelah? karena bekerja seharian). Subjek 'I' membutuhkan 'am' dalam struktur 'be going to'. Pilihan 'but' salah karena tidak menunjukkan kontras, dan 'is' salah karena tidak cocok dengan subjek 'I'.

quiz.question: Last week, I ___ my friend at the mall. We had coffee, and ___ we watched a movie.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini menggunakan Simple Past karena ada penanda waktu 'last week'. 'Meet' berubah menjadi 'met'. Kata 'then' atau 'after that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan urutan kegiatan (pertama ngopi, lalu nonton film). 'So' salah karena menunjukkan hasil, bukan urutan waktu.

quiz.question: I ___ visit my grandparents next Sunday. I miss them ___ I didn't see them last month.
quiz.explanation: Untuk rencana masa depan, kita gunakan 'be going to' dengan struktur lengkap. Subjek 'I' memerlukan 'am'. 'Because' digunakan untuk menjelaskan alasan (kenapa rindu? karena tidak bertemu bulan lalu). Tanpa 'am', struktur 'going to' tidak lengkap.

quiz.question: The concert last night was amazing, ___ now I'm exhausted. I ___ sleep all day tomorrow.
quiz.explanation: 'But' digunakan untuk menunjukkan kontras (konser bagus, tapi sekarang lelah). Struktur lengkap 'be going to' adalah 'am going to' + verb 1. 'Am going' tanpa 'to' tidak tepat, dan 'going to' tanpa 'am' tidak lengkap untuk subjek 'I'.

modules.title: Ujian Kelulusan Akhir A1: 4-Skills CEFR A1 Graduation Exam
modules.objective: Ujian kelulusan akhir CEFR A1 komprehensif 4 keterampilan (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) untuk membuka Level A2

theory.summary: Ujian kelulusan ini mengevaluasi seluruh kemampuan bahasa Inggris dasar level A1 Anda dalam empat keterampilan: mendengarkan, membaca, menulis, dan berbicara. Anda akan diuji dalam membandingkan hal-hal, menceritakan pengalaman liburan, merencanakan masa depan dengan 'be going to', mendeskripsikan penampilan dan karakter orang, serta memberikan alasan dengan 'because'. Ujian ini dirancang untuk memastikan Anda siap melanjutkan ke level A2. Kerjakan dengan tenang dan percaya diri!
rules: Comparative adjectives: Gunakan 'adjective + -er + than' untuk membandingkan dua hal (bigger than, faster than, nicer than). Formula: [Subject] + [be] + [adjective-er] + than + [object]
Be going to: Gunakan 'am/is/are going to + verb' untuk menyatakan rencana masa depan. Formula: [Subject] + [am/is/are] + going to + [verb infinitive]
Physical descriptions: Gunakan 'has/have + noun' untuk penampilan fisik (has blue eyes, have long hair) dan 'is/are + adjective' untuk karakteristik (is tall, are friendly)
Giving reasons: Gunakan 'because' untuk memberikan alasan. Formula: [Statement] + because + [reason]. Contoh: 'I like summer because it's warm.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Peringatan Kesalahan Umum pada Ujian A1
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa lupa menambahkan 'than' setelah comparative adjective, atau salah menempatkan 'to' dalam struktur 'be going to'. Selain itu, sering terjadi kesalahan dalam memilih 'has' vs 'have' berdasarkan subjek.
commonTrap.wrong: My brother is tall from me. I going to visit my grandma. She have brown eyes.
commonTrap.correct: My brother is taller than me. I am going to visit my grandma. She has brown eyes.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Hi Tom! Are you ready for the graduation exam tomorrow?
lines.translation: Hai Tom! Apakah kamu siap untuk ujian kelulusan besok?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes, I am! I studied all the grammar and vocabulary. What about you?

lines.speaker: Sarah

lines.translation: Saya sedikit gugup karena ujiannya lebih panjang dari tes latihan.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Don't worry! If we pass, we're going to start A2 level next month.
lines.translation: Jangan khawatir! Jika kita lulus, kita akan mulai level A2 bulan depan.

lines.translation: Saya juga! Saya ingin meningkatkan speaking saya karena itu lebih sulit daripada writing bagi saya.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Good luck tomorrow! Let's do our best!
lines.translation: Semoga berhasil besok! Ayo kita lakukan yang terbaik!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Good luck to you too, Sarah!
lines.translation: Semoga berhasil juga untukmu, Sarah!

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang melakukan latihan akhir dengan Mr. Khoirul sebelum ujian kelulusan A1. Beliau akan menanyakan tentang pengalaman belajar Anda dan rencana masa depan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Welcome to your final speaking practice before the graduation exam. How are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hello, Mr. Khoirul! I'm feeling good but a little nervous about the exam.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's normal! Tell me, which skill is easier for you - listening or reading?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think listening is easier than reading because I practice it every day.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! What are you going to do after you pass the A1 exam?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm going to start A2 level and I'm going to practice speaking more.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a great plan! Why do you want to learn English?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I want to learn English because I want to travel to other countries and make international friends.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'Hi, I'm Anna. Last summer, I went to Bali with my family. We stayed at a hotel near the beach. The weather was sunny and hot. I swam in the ocean every day. It was more fun than staying at home!' - Where did Anna go last summer?
quiz.explanation: Dalam transkrip audio, Anna dengan jelas menyebutkan 'Last summer, I went to Bali with my family.' Jawaban yang benar adalah 'To Bali'.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'My name is David. I have short black hair and brown eyes. I'm tall and I wear glasses. People say I'm friendly and funny. I like playing football with my friends.' - What does David look like?
options: He has long hair and is short
He has short black hair and is tall
He has blond hair and green eyes
quiz.answer: He has short black hair and is tall
quiz.explanation: David mendeskripsikan dirinya dengan jelas: 'I have short black hair' dan 'I'm tall'. Jawaban yang tepat adalah 'He has short black hair and is tall'.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'This is Sarah. I'm going to visit my grandparents next weekend. I'm going to help them in the garden. We're going to cook dinner together on Sunday. I'm very excited!' - What is Sarah going to do next weekend?
options: She's going to visit her grandparents
She's going to study at home
quiz.answer: She's going to visit her grandparents
quiz.explanation: Sarah menyatakan rencananya dengan jelas: 'I'm going to visit my grandparents next weekend.' Ini adalah contoh penggunaan 'be going to' untuk rencana masa depan.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'I love summer because it's warm and sunny. My brother likes winter more than summer because he likes skiing. I think summer is better than winter because I can swim and play outside.' - Why does the speaker like summer?
quiz.explanation: Pembicara memberikan alasan yang jelas: 'I love summer because it's warm and sunny.' Kata 'because' digunakan untuk memberikan alasan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'My name is Lisa. I'm from Indonesia. I'm 25 years old. I have long brown hair and green eyes. I'm a teacher at a primary school. I teach English to young children. I love my job because the children are very cute and happy.' - What is Lisa's job?
quiz.explanation: Dalam teks, Lisa menyatakan dengan jelas: 'I'm a teacher at a primary school.' Jawaban yang benar adalah 'She's a teacher'.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'Tokyo is bigger than Jakarta. London is older than Tokyo. Paris is more beautiful than London. But I think Jakarta is more interesting than all of them because it's my home city and I know it very well.' - According to the text, which city is bigger?
quiz.explanation: Kalimat pertama dalam teks menyatakan: 'Tokyo is bigger than Jakarta.' Ini adalah perbandingan langsung menggunakan comparative adjective.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'Next month, my family is going to move to a new house. The new house is larger than our old house. It has four bedrooms and a big garden. I'm going to have my own bedroom! I'm very happy because I'm going to decorate it myself.' - What is the family going to do next month?
options: They're going to buy a car
They're going to move to a new house
They're going to go on vacation
quiz.answer: They're going to move to a new house
quiz.explanation: Kalimat pembuka teks menyatakan rencana masa depan: 'Next month, my family is going to move to a new house.' Ini menggunakan struktur 'be going to' untuk rencana.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'My best friend Emma has blue eyes and blond hair. She's taller than me. She's very kind and helpful. She always helps me with my homework. I like her because she's funny and we laugh a lot together.' - Why does the writer like Emma?
quiz.explanation: Penulis memberikan alasan yang jelas di akhir teks: 'I like her because she's funny and we laugh a lot together.' Kata 'because' menunjukkan alasan.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the correct sentence:
options: My house is more big than yours.
My house is bigger than yours.
My house is more bigger than yours.
quiz.answer: My house is bigger than yours.
quiz.explanation: Untuk kata sifat pendek seperti 'big', kita menambahkan '-er' dan 'than' untuk membuat comparative. 'More big' dan 'more bigger' adalah kesalahan umum. Bentuk yang benar adalah 'bigger than'.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Complete the sentence: 'I ___ visit my uncle tomorrow.'
quiz.explanation: Struktur lengkap 'be going to' memerlukan kata kerja bantu 'am/is/are' + 'going to' + verb infinitive. Karena subjeknya 'I', maka yang benar adalah 'am going to'.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the correct sentence:
options: She is have long black hair.
quiz.explanation: Untuk subjek orang ketiga tunggal (she/he/it), kita menggunakan 'has', bukan 'have'. Untuk mendeskripsikan penampilan fisik, kita menggunakan 'has/have + noun'.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Complete the sentence with the correct reason: 'I like winter ___ I can play in the snow.'
quiz.explanation: Kata 'because' digunakan untuk memberikan alasan atau sebab. Kalimat ini menjelaskan mengapa penulis menyukai musim dingin, yaitu karena bisa bermain di salju.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Your friend asks: 'What are you going to do this weekend?' What is the best response?
options: I go to the cinema yesterday.
I'm going to visit my cousin.
quiz.answer: I'm going to visit my cousin.
quiz.explanation: Pertanyaan menggunakan 'be going to' untuk menanyakan rencana masa depan, jadi jawaban harus menggunakan struktur yang sama. 'I'm going to visit my cousin' adalah respons yang tepat dan natural.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Someone asks: 'Why do you study English?' What is the most appropriate answer?
options: Because I want to travel abroad.
quiz.answer: Because I want to travel abroad.
quiz.explanation: Pertanyaan 'Why' memerlukan jawaban yang berisi alasan. Jawaban yang paling tepat dimulai dengan 'because' dan memberikan alasan yang jelas, seperti 'Because I want to travel abroad.'

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Your teacher asks: 'Which is more difficult for you, speaking or writing?' How should you respond?
options: I think speaking is more difficult than writing.
quiz.answer: I think speaking is more difficult than writing.
quiz.explanation: Pertanyaan meminta perbandingan antara dua keterampilan. Jawaban yang baik menggunakan comparative adjective dengan struktur 'more difficult than' untuk membandingkan kedua hal tersebut.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] A new classmate asks: 'Can you describe yourself?' What is the best way to answer?
options: I have short hair and I'm friendly.
quiz.answer: I have short hair and I'm friendly.
quiz.explanation: Pertanyaan meminta deskripsi diri. Jawaban yang baik mencakup penampilan fisik (I have short hair) dan karakter (I'm friendly). Ini menunjukkan kemampuan mendeskripsikan appearance dan character.
